stem.text: What will reduce the systematic errors when taking a measurement?

A.text: adjusting the needle on a voltmeter so that it reads zero when there is no potential difference across it

B.text: measuring the diameter of a wire at different points and taking the average

C.text: reducing the parallax effects by using a marker and a mirror when measuring the amplitude of oscillation of a pendulum

D.text: timing 20 oscillations, rather than a single oscillation, when finding the period of a pendulum
